description: Active Enyo NNUE improvement-run config. Use this as the reviewed candidate recipe.
goal: Scale the cp-only Bullet/Reckless-like run after the 1M-row checkpoint improved static MAE but still failed SPRT catastrophically. This run is gate-only: train on more rows and inspect static/move-choice behavior before considering any SPRT.

success_condition: static eval sign/MAE improves materially over the 1M cp-only Bullet run
slope moves closer to the Stockfish-labeled target instead of staying heavily compressed
Enyo evalnet check passes after loading quantised.bin
move-choice gate improves without catastrophic tail positions
next_after_success: run checkpoint sweep over selected superbatches
run evalnet check/bench on the best quantised.bin
run move-choice gate against repeated-tail and SPRT-opening failure positions
only consider SPRT if static slope/sign and move-choice gates are clean
